abstract: Visual world models increasingly support spatial reasoning by generating RGB views of unobserved states. However, RGB has become the default interface largely because it is well suited for visual generation, rather than necessarily being the most effective representation for downstream reasoning. Different spatial questions may benefit from different representations of the same imagined state: top-down geometry can facilitate global distance comparisons, while panoramic views provide broader context for reasoning about open space. To isolate the role of representation in spatial imagination, we introduce ImagiRep, a simulator-grounded benchmark of 922 questions spanning seven question types across two settings, Viewpoint Imagination and Cross-view Integration, providing oracle RGB and six alternative representations (e.g., depth, panoramic views, and top-down geometry) of the same unobserved state. This controlled comparison reveals that even accurate imagined RGB does not guarantee accurate spatial reasoning, and different questions benefit from different representations. Similar trends hold for representations derived from world-model-estimated states. Notably, estimated RGB alone can mislead spatial reasoning, while alternative representations retain complementary benefits. Building on these findings, we introduce GEARS, a lightweight test-time strategy for adaptive representation selection, outperforming existing spatial imagination methods and showing that reasoning about unseen states requires more than generating RGB views.
summary_zh: 现有视觉世界模型默认用RGB表征未见状态，但RGB未必是下游空间推理的最有效表征。
提出ImagiRep基准，包含922个问题及7种替代表征，对比发现准确RGB不保证推理准确，不同问题需不同表征。
提出GEARS自适应表征选择策略，优于现有方法，证明空间推理需超越生成RGB视图。

title: FeatureArc: Benchmarking Coding Agents on Evolving Features
title_zh: FeatureArc：评估编程Agent功能演进的基准
abstract: A software feature usually evolves over time: developers extend its first version as new use cases and requirements arrive, and each extension builds on code written earlier. Most feature benchmarks evaluate a single request on a fixed codebase. Feature evolution requires evaluating successive extensions on an agent's own earlier code and checking whether the feature remains correct. We introduce FeatureArc to evaluate coding agents on evolving features, together with a pipeline that constructs its tasks from repository histories. The benchmark combines dependencies between successive stages of the same feature, explicit requirements and interface contracts, and executable checks across four programming languages. The pipeline validates fail-to-pass (F2P) tests for new behavior and pass-to-pass (P2P) tests for existing behavior on the reference code before and after each stage. We evaluated 10 coding agents on 73 manually reviewed tasks of 2 to 10 stages. Each agent works in one persistent session and workspace without external test feedback or rollback. The evaluation reveals a gap between first-stage and whole-feature success: pooled success falls from 62.7% at the first stage to 28.5% when the whole feature is tested on the final code. Trajectory analysis identifies inherited defects as a common failure mechanism, present in 72.9% of failed later stages. These earlier errors often remain undetected: in stages following a failure, agents leave the earlier error unnoticed about 95% of the time, and their self-tests rarely revisit earlier stages. Evolving a feature autonomously, without human checks between stages, therefore remains a substantial challenge for current coding agents. At Tencent, the pipeline extends internal evaluations to this setting and guides the development of Hunyuan, Tencent's family of large language models.
summary_zh: 现有基准多评估固定代码库上的单次请求，无法评估Agent在自身早期代码上连续扩展功能的演进能力。
提出FeatureArc基准及构建流水线，结合依赖关系与接口契约，通过F2P与P2P测试验证新旧行为的正确性。
对10个Agent的评估显示整体功能成功率骤降，72.9%的后续失败源于继承缺陷，且Agent极少察觉早期错误。

title: Bayes-Adaptive MDPs for Rollout Allocation to Enhance GRPO Training
title_zh: 基于贝叶斯自适应MDP的GRPO训练推演分配方法
abstract: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has demonstrated strong performance in LLM post-training. However, it allocates a uniform rollout budget to every training question, ignoring variations in question difficulty. As a result, highly difficult questions may receive too few rollouts to generate informative positive reward signals, limiting their contribution to training, while moderately difficult questions often receive more rollouts than necessary. In this work, we formulate the problem of difficulty-aware rollout budget allocation to maximize training utility under the same total rollout budget as standard GRPO. We propose AdaRoll-GRPO, which reformulates rollout allocation as a sequential decision-making problem and leverages a Bayes-adaptive Markov decision process (MDP) to learn an adaptive allocation policy. The learned policy is computed offline and applied during GRPO training without introducing additional online optimization overhead. Extensive experiments on multiple reasoning datasets and LLM architectures demonstrate that AdaRoll-GRPO consistently improves GRPO training performance under a fixed rollout budget, highlighting the effectiveness of adaptive rollout allocation for GRPO in LLM post-training.
summary_zh: GRPO均匀分配推演预算，忽略问题难度差异，导致难问题正奖励信号不足而中等问题预算浪费。
将推演分配建模为序贯决策问题，提出AdaRoll-GRPO，利用贝叶斯自适应MDP学习自适应分配策略。
所学策略离线计算且无额外在线开销，实验表明在固定预算下AdaRoll-GRPO一致提升了GRPO性能。

title: The Envelope Layer: An Underestimated Surface of LLM Agent Defense
title_zh: 信封层：被低估的LLM Agent防御面
abstract: Prior work framed the envelope layer as the channel through which malicious content enters an agent, and established it as a defense surface independent of the LLM layer and the agent layer; however, that work only tested the envelope layer briefly and did not examine how label strength, envelope authenticity, scaffold differences, or existing memories affect defense effectiveness. Following its GDA Measurement methodology and the A/B/C/D outcome taxonomy, this paper takes the A2A-TIBA attack as the test vehicle, uses the semantic breach rate as the primary indicator with the semantic refusal rate as its complementary reference, and characterizes the security boundary of the envelope layer through a two-by-two factorial experiment and a memory experiment. The results show that: when the envelope is authentic, strong labels consistently reduce the semantic breach rate, whereas weak labels are not necessarily better than an unlabeled baseline; when the envelope can be forged, the benefit of strong labels is weakened and its direction varies across frontends; and memory has a larger effect than any label manipulation: success memory raises the semantic breach rate while failure memory lowers it, and most combinations that contain both experiences return to the no-memory baseline. Accordingly, this paper refines the envelope layer from a single admission channel into two levels, an admission channel plus a context assembly surface, and argues that its security boundary is not a fixed property of labels but a dynamic outcome jointly shaped by label claims, frontend permissions, and historical memory.
summary_zh: 先前研究将信封层视为恶意内容入口，但未充分验证标签强度、信封真实性及记忆等因素/脚手架差异对防御的影响。
本文采用2×2因子与记忆实验，以语义突破率为主指标，刻画信封层的安全边界。
真实信封下强标签可降突破率，伪造时强标签优势减弱；成败记忆对突破率影响更大。据此将信封层细化为入口与上下文组装面，指出其边界由标签、前端权限与记忆动态共同塑造。

title: Constraining the Commit Boundary: A DIO/ODI-Informed Authorization Guardrail for Agentic Entity Resolution
title_zh: 基于DIO/ODI的智能体实体消解授权边界约束
abstract: Agentic Entity Resolution (ER) systems iteratively plan actions, retrieve evidence, revise hypotheses, and propose graph mutations. An erroneous identity hypothesis may condition later retrieval and produce apparent confirmation. This paper proposes a Digital Identity Optimization (DIO) and Ontology of Digital Identity (ODI)-informed authorization boundary between evidence available for agent reasoning and evidence eligible to authorize persistent identity-changing mutations. A domain-governed constraint-binding function maps selected reconstruction-failure distinctions to explicit identity-preserving constraints. An abstract two-phase supervisor permits a commit only when claim-specific authorization-eligible evidence supports every required proposition, relevant conflicts are resolved, the operation remains within its authorized scope, and relevant state and policy versions remain valid. Admission as UNVERIFIED does not confer authorization eligibility. Separate claim-specific promotion governs evidentiary use; insufficient support or unresolved material conflict leads to deferral. The contribution is a specification connecting diagnostic-to-constraint mapping, evidence promotion, proposition coverage, conflict handling, scope binding, and commit-time version integrity. A proposed evaluation protocol is designed to assess the mapping's incremental value beyond generic authorization and conventional identifier rules. This is a conceptual architecture without implementation or empirical validation, not a theorem of semantic correctness. Its property depends on domain-policy adequacy, evidence promotion, and enforcement. It does not prevent erroneous hypotheses or hypothesis-conditioned retrieval; dependency-aware evidence flow remains future research.
summary_zh: 智能体实体消解中错误假设会误导检索，需隔离推理与持久化修改的授权。
提出DIO/ODI授权边界，将诊断映射为约束，两阶段监督器验证证据与合规性。
贡献为连接诊断、证据提升与冲突处理等规范的架构，目前仅为概念设计。

title: Clearing the FoG: Training KG Agents to Retrieve the Evidence Behind Their Answers
title_zh: 消除迷雾：训练知识图谱Agent检索答案背后的证据
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can answer many factual questions correctly, but a correct answer is not necessarily a supported one. For an LLM agent, a knowledge graph (KG) plays two roles: as a source of answers, it supplies facts that the model lacks; as a source of evidence, it supplies the supporting triples that make an answer traceable and auditable. However, existing KG agents treat the KG only as a source of answers: their training data carries answers but not evidence, and their training rewards check the answer but not the retrieved evidence, so agents often answer correctly without retrieving the supporting triples. We propose FoG, a framework that trains KG agents to retrieve the evidence behind their answers. FoG consists of evidence-grounded synthesis, a KG interaction agent, and an evidence-coverage process reward (ECPR): the synthesis recursively hides explicit entities behind verifiable sub-questions, so that every question carries its supporting triples by construction; the agent records the triples returned by the KG; and ECPR credits each supporting triple to the turn that first retrieves it. Experiments on three KGQA benchmarks demonstrate that FoG enables 3B--4B open-source agents to outperform substantially larger baselines in answer accuracy and evidence coverage, with zero-shot cross-KG transfer.
summary_zh: 现有KG Agent仅将知识图谱作为答案源，训练缺乏证据监督，导致常答对却不检索支撑三元组。
提出FoG框架，通过证据锚定合成构造带支撑三元组的数据，并设计证据覆盖率过程奖励ECPR。
实验表明，FoG使3B-4B开源Agent在答案准确率和证据覆盖率上超越更大基线，且支持零样本跨图谱迁移。

title: LinMix: Data Mixing as Linear Domain Attribution
title_zh: LinMix：基于线性域归因的数据混合方法
abstract: Language model performance depends strongly on the mixture of domains in the pretraining data corpus. Popular data mixing methods select these domain weights by training many small proxy models on random mixes and then fitting a regression model to predict performance from the mix. We recognize this practice as a domain attribution problem, where the regression measures each domain's contribution to the target metric. Through this lens, the standard Dirichlet sampling of proxy data mixes is a poor regression design that requires tuning and cannot support a linear fit for hundreds of domains. Building on classical optimal experimental design, we introduce LinMix, which samples mixes at the vertices of the capped simplex so that each domain is at its cap or absent. This hyperparameter-free vertex sampling decorrelates domain effects, enabling an interpretable linear model whose coefficients are the domain attributions. The optimal mix given by LinMix provably keeps only domains with positive attribution values and requires no search over candidate mixes. We further establish the optimality of vertex sampling, and prove that Dirichlet sampling inflates the attribution error when its mixes concentrate around the prior data mix. Pretraining experiments with 1B-parameter OLMo2 and 4B Qwen3.5 language models show that LinMix outperforms Dirichlet-based data mixing across reasoning, code, and math benchmarks, with relative gains of 46% on MBPP and 14% on GSM8K. At 288 fine-grained domains, only vertex sampling supports a linear fit, and LinMix improves benchmark accuracy by 11% on average over the best nonlinear baseline.
summary_zh: 现有数据混合方法用Dirichlet采样训练代理模型并回归预测性能，但该设计需调参且无法支持数百个域的线性拟合。
提出LinMix方法，基于最优实验设计在封顶单纯形顶点采样，解耦域效应，构建无超参数且可解释的线性域归因模型。
实验表明，LinMix在1B和4B模型预训练中显著优于Dirichlet方法，在MBPP和GSM8K上相对提升46%和14%。
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Attributing Model Behavior at Scale

title: VLA-Stem: A Lightweight Safety Mechanism for Vision-Language-Action Models via Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: VLA-Stem：基于强化学习的轻量级VLA模型安全机制
abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models integrate high-level reasoning with low-level action execution for end-to-end robotic control. However, most VLA models target static manipulation in unconstrained environments, overlooking spatial constraints and dynamic obstacles. Fine-tuning VLAs on obstacle-avoidance data is a straightforward solution, but collecting such data is costly, especially for dynamic scenarios, and may degrade their original task capabilities. To address these limitations, we propose VLA-Stem, a lightweight, reinforcement-learning-based safety mechanism for VLA systems. Without fine-tuning the underlying VLA policy, VLA-Stem converts its action chunks into motion references and uses trajectory-level guidance to preserve their spatial intent while allowing flexible motion and timing adjustments. Conditioned on these references, robot proprioception, and local obstacle information, the Stem policy adaptively modifies execution at inference time, preserving the original task intent while enabling responsive adaptation to spatial constraints and dynamic obstacles. For robust and sample-efficient training, we combine teacher-student distillation with curriculum learning. We evaluate VLA-Stem on reference following, static spatial constraints, and dynamic obstacle avoidance. Across six constrained simulation settings, VLA-Stem achieves 52.8% average collision-free task success versus 23.7% for the strongest safety baseline, while preserving base-policy performance in obstacle-free settings; real-world experiments further show consistent collision reductions under static and dynamic obstacles. These results demonstrate that VLA-Stem couples high-level VLA task intent with rapid, reflex-like responses to immediate physical risks, providing a brainstem-inspired mechanism for robust robot execution.
summary_zh: 现有VLA模型多忽略空间约束与动态障碍，微调避障数据成本高且易损害原任务能力。
提出VLA-Stem安全机制，无需微调原策略，通过轨迹级引导在推理时自适应调整动作执行。
该方法在受限仿真中无碰撞成功率52.8%，远超基线23.7%，且不损及原任务性能。

title: Agent-Conditioned Routing: Diverse Reasoning Paths Within One Frozen Model
title_zh: 基于智能体条件路由的单一冻结模型多样推理路径
abstract: Generating several solutions can expose alternative methods, but additional trajectories often paraphrase one dominant approach. We investigate whether the conditional capacity of a frozen sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) model can provide such diversity from one problem prompt, without user-assigned roles, prescribed methods, fine-tuning, or model copies. Agent-Conditioned Routing (ACR) assigns $m$ parallel trajectories persistent, untrained shared/private expert-eligibility masks while preserving the learned, input-dependent token router. On a screened 126-question multi-mode mathematics and physics benchmark, with model judges reading the reported derivations in full, we count the number of problems yielding at least two distinct primary methods among soft-correct solutions in four trajectories. ACR reaches approximately twice as many such problems as the strongest temperature setting under GLM 5.3 (37.3 versus 18.7), and 1.67 times as many under GPT-5.6 Sol (45.00 versus 27.00), at matched output budgets. A blinded four-expert audit on a stratified sample of 30 problems also finds more multi-method solutions with ACR on both backbones, with lower correctness. Matched-eligibility ablations show modest multi-method count advantages for ACR, while token-resampled masks attain higher correctness. An informed sequential prompt elicits more diversity still, using previous solutions and explicit requests for alternative methods. ACR adds about 160 KiB of mask state. In a three-problem microbenchmark capped at 1,024 tokens, its latency and peak VRAM usage remain within 3% of batched temperature sampling.
summary_zh: 多次生成解决方案常陷入同质化。本文提出ACR，利用冻结MoE模型的条件容量，无需微调或角色分配即可生成多样推理路径。
ACR为并行轨迹分配持久的共享/私有专家资格掩码，保留已学习的输入依赖路由器，仅增加约160KiB状态且延迟与显存开销极低。
在数理基准测试中，ACR获得多种解法的问题数约为最强温度采样的2倍；但正确率有所降低，且不如结合前序解法的顺序提示多样。
comment: 17 pages, 4 figures, 11 tables. Extended version of a paper accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Resource-Aware Agentic AI (non-archival)

title: Uncovering Why LLMs Fail: From Internal Mechanisms to Adversarial Reasoning Trajectories
title_zh: 揭示大模型失败原因：从内部机制到对抗推理轨迹
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are usually evaluated by final-output correctness or safety, yet an endpoint label does not reveal how a failure develops throughout the reasoning process. We therefore ask whether ordinary reasoning failures and adversarially induced failures can be characterized using the same internal coordinates. Towards this end, we in this paper study a white-box diagnostic framework CauTrace to disclose the root-cause of why LLM fails from three fundamental inspections: Functional States, Propagation of Representation, Temporal-State Coordination and Reasoning Trajectory. First, seven functional states are creatively defined to represent the support and constraint processing in LLMs. Second, the propagation of representation change measures how the changes among the seven states persist across subsequent Transformer blocks. Third, temporal-state coordination and trajectory topology characterize when the commitment and verification occur relative to the support, and how the dominant state sequence evolves over the full inference process. Finally, we evaluate CauTrace on both clean reasoning failures and paired adversarial perturbations. Across Qwen and LLaMA-family models, the failed traces show weaker Attention-MLP agreement on support-state updates and less verification activity relative to commitment, while the exact representation-level signatures and timing shifts vary by architecture. Held-out repair and steering tests demonstrate consistent operational signals that were in line with our claims for certain models and specific settings, with aligned steering producing the predicted directional changes in process measures. Overall, CauTrace provides a unified diagnostic framework for analyzing failure dynamics through changes in support, commitment, and verification, which would shed light on the in-depth research on LLM security.
summary_zh: 仅靠最终输出无法揭示LLM推理失败的发展过程，需从内部机制统一刻画普通与对抗诱导的失败。
提出白盒诊断框架CauTrace，通过功能状态、表征传播及时间状态协调与推理轨迹，定位失败根因。
实验发现失败轨迹的Attention-MLP一致性较弱且验证活动较少，且修复与引导测试验证了该框架的有效性。

title: When Is Additional Retrieval Worthwhile? A Cost-Aware Study of Evidence Gain and Answer Reliability in RAG
title_zh: RAG中额外检索的价值：基于证据增益与答案可靠性的成本感知研究
abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) can benefit from more sophisticated retrieval, but extra retrieval may be unnecessary for many questions and gains in evidence retrieval may not translate into faithful or correct answers. We study a cost-aware, two-action retrieval policy that chooses between a dense-retrieval-plus-reranking baseline and a hybrid lexical--dense retriever. Rather than classifying baseline retrieval as simply successful or unsuccessful, we estimate the question-specific incremental evidence-retrieval benefit of hybrid retrieval using features available before the routing decision. A regularized linear model and decision threshold are selected using document-grouped cross-validation and frozen prior to held-out evaluation. On 60 previously unseen QASPER training-split articles (188 questions, 169 evidence-evaluable), the policy triggers hybrid retrieval on 46 questions (24.5\%) and obtains the same evidence Hit@10 as always-hybrid retrieval (78.70\%, versus 76.92\% for always-keep). Paired, paper-cluster bootstrap intervals do not establish a reliable utility advantage. We further compare generated answers from a 4-bit Qwen3-4B model under the three retrieval policies. Provisional answer-level assessments show no clear correctness or faithfulness improvement after partial review, despite the evidence-retrieval result. The generation assessments remain model-assisted and lack independent human validation. These results expose an important distinction between retrieving relevant evidence efficiently and improving the reliability of the generated answer. The work is presented as a reproducible empirical study, not a claim of statistically established answer-quality superiority.
summary_zh: RAG中额外检索未必提升答案可靠性，需权衡检索成本与答案质量。
提出成本感知双动作检索策略，基于预路由特征估计增量证据收益，在路由决策前选择混合检索或基线检索。
实验表明该策略以低触发率匹配全量混合检索的证据命中率，但未显著提升生成答案的正确性与忠实度。

title: Aligning Institutional Power and Operational Ability
title_zh: 对齐制度权力与操作能力
abstract: To be socially sustainable, Agentic AI systems require normative designs that align responsibilities with the ability to fulfil them. Identifying incongruences such as unsatisfiable expectations or privilege escalation is crucial in avoiding normative pitfalls. In this study, we discuss design dimensions suitable for describing multi-agent systems in light of this norm-ability alignment requirement. We propose a formal framework centred on process-oriented modelling and institutional power for the analysis of a given normatively relevant process, discuss strategies for repairing it, and elaborate on how the symmetrical relation between operational process and institutional state affects the lifecycle of normative positions.
summary_zh: Agentic AI 需对齐责任与能力，以避免不可满足的期望或权限升级等规范陷阱。
提出以过程导向建模和制度权力为中心的形式化框架，分析规范相关过程。
探讨过程修复策略，阐明操作过程与制度状态的对称关系对规范位置生命周期的影响。

title: CodeCap-Bench: Can Code Serve as a Good Video Caption?
title_zh: CodeCap-Bench：代码能否作为优质视频描述
abstract: Video captioning aims to preserve visual information through compact descriptions, predominantly using natural language. However, precisely expressing fine-grained spatial structures and temporal dynamics in natural language often leads to lengthy and potentially ambiguous descriptions. In this work, we explore Code as Video Caption, a paradigm where executable programs serve as a complementary representation of visual content through graphical primitives, layout rules, and functions of time. To examine whether code captions effectively preserve video information, we compare them with natural language captions on downstream question answering and video reconstruction tasks. Our results show that code captions achieve superior reasoning accuracy and reconstruction fidelity. Despite these advantages, realizing the potential of code captioning depends on whether current multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can generate faithful code captions. To systematically assess this capability, we introduce CodeCap-Bench, which comprises 323 videos spanning five categories of structured 2D content, along with fine-grained annotations and a multi-level evaluation framework. Extensive experiments reveal that while leading proprietary MLLMs demonstrate promising code captioning capabilities, they still struggle to faithfully capture complex temporal dynamics, with open-source models lagging substantially behind.
summary_zh: 自然语言描述视频易冗长且模糊，提出用可执行程序作为视频描述，以精准表达时空动态。
在问答与视频重建任务上对比发现，代码描述在推理准确度和重建保真度上均优于自然语言。
构建CodeCap-Bench评估MLLM生成代码描述的能力，发现现有模型难以忠实捕捉复杂时序动态。

title: Mind the Intent Gap: A Methodology for Collaborative Agent-Driven Software Engineering
title_zh: 协作智能体驱动的意图对齐软件工程方法论
abstract: AI agents have entered software teams, first as tools and now as team members. They produce in minutes what used to take days, yet the expected gain in delivery often fails to appear. We argue that they are entering processes designed for people, which quietly relied on people to cover three of their weaknesses. The team's intent was never fully written down, because colleagues filled the gaps. An AI agent fills them too, though by guessing, and drifts from what the team had in mind. The reasoning behind each deliverable was already lost from one step to the next, and AI agents now inflate and deflate the documents passed along. The reasoning people did alone was partly private and now moves into AI tools that keep it private by nature. We present CAIA, for Collaborative Agentic Intent Alignment, a methodology for software teams that brings agents into the way they work. A knowledge base describes the product that a project maintains. For each Change, a micro-team aligns on its intent before agents evolve the product and propose updates to the Knowledge Base. The proposed CAIA methodology emerged from an industrial need and is already in use at Ni2, with a platform built to support it. We present the methodology and outline our plans to evaluate it further.
summary_zh: AI agent进入为人设计的流程时，因靠猜测填补意图缺口、放大文档推理流失及私有推理不透明，导致交付增益未达预期。
提出协作智能体意图对齐方法CAIA，通过知识库描述产品，要求微团队在agent演进产品前先对齐每次变更的意图。
CAIA源于工业需求，已在Ni2公司落地并获平台支持，后续计划对该方法论开展进一步评估。

title: CoS-VQ: Coordinated Shared-Scale Vector Quantization for Large Language Models
title_zh: 面向大语言模型的协调共享尺度向量量化CoS-VQ
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) require substantial memory, motivating low-bit weight quantization for efficient deployment. Existing vector quantization (VQ) methods often improve accuracy by increasing the effective coding dimension, which can complicate independent lookup and local codeword updates. We propose CoS-VQ (Coordinated Shared-Scale Vector Quantization), which preserves low-dimensional codewords while jointly optimizing hard indices and their shared scale across positions. The key challenge is scale-induced coupling: the optimal scale depends on the entire codeword combination and, in turn, changes candidate rankings across positions, so pointwise updates can stall even after scale re-optimization. CoS-VQ collects candidates at multiple probe scales and constructs a tangent separable upper bound for the residual-aware quadratic objective. By reducing candidate comparisons to lower envelopes of lines over positive scales, it identifies finitely many representative intervals for joint index--scale updates without exhaustively enumerating codeword combinations. On Qwen3.8-27B, CoS-VQ outperforms QTIP and LLVQ on the evaluated language modeling, coding, and reasoning benchmarks. Ablations from the same initialization further show larger gains from joint updates than from scale-only refinement, highlighting joint selection as an alternative to increasing codeword dimensionality. The code is available at https://github.com/xzktx003/Cos_VQ.
summary_zh: LLM内存消耗大，现有VQ方法增加编码维度易破坏独立查找，本文提出保留低维码字的CoS-VQ方法。
针对尺度耦合导致逐点更新易停滞的问题，CoS-VQ通过多探测尺度与切线上界，实现索引与尺度的联合优化。
在Qwen3.8-27B上CoS-VQ优于QTIP和LLVQ，消融实验证明联合更新比仅优化尺度收益更大。

title: Hidden in Plain Sight: an Empirical Study about The Instruction Stacks of Coding Agents
title_zh: 编码智能体指令栈的实证研究
abstract: Coding agents send their models more than the user's prompt: they add instructions, tool definitions, and environmental context that form an instruction stack. This stack guides execution and changes across releases, yet remains largely unexposed to users and insufficiently characterized in research. We present a longitudinal, cross-agent study of the instruction stacks captured in the first model requests of 1,886 releases of Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Qwen Code, and OpenCode. Under controlled conditions, we analyze their composition and evolution and trace changes in the four open-source agents to documented motivations. Our findings show why examining the system prompt or reporting the model alone provides an incomplete account of agent inputs. Tool definitions dominate three agents' latest requests, while occasional concentrated revisions alter instructions governing tool use, attribution, and coding style. Such revisions can complicate how researchers identify agent-authored contributions and interpret generated code. We also found that only 48% of examined change units directly explain the motivation for stack revisions. Across agents, shared capabilities emerge despite increasingly distinct wording. These findings expose an evolving, incompletely documented layer of agent design. The findings motivate documenting captured instruction stacks alongside agent releases, models, and user prompts, and preserving the rationale behind their revisions.
summary_zh: 编码智能体的指令栈对用户不可见且缺乏研究，需纵向跨智能体分析其组成与演变。
采集5个编码智能体1886个版本的指令栈，分析其组成演变并追踪开源版本的修改动机。
工具定义主导多数智能体输入，指令修改缺乏文档记录，建议随版本发布完整记录指令栈及修改动机。

title: AnalogScout: Simulation-Efficient PVT-Aware Analog Sizing with LLM Agents
title_zh: 基于LLM代理的模拟电路高效PVT感知尺寸优化框架
abstract: Analog device sizing must satisfy all specifications across process, voltage, and temperature (PVT) corners to ensure tape-out success, but simulating every candidate at all corners dominates the sizing time and slows design iteration. Conventional surrogate-based optimizers search the sizing space directly, while recent large language model (LLM) agents add circuit knowledge to designs but still delegate the sizes to global optimizers. Both learn the circuit response from repeated multi-corner SPICE simulations and optimize on top of it, which becomes expensive under a limited simulation budget. Providing an agent with reusable verified designs and sizing sub-blocks analytically could save most of this budget. We propose AnalogScout, a simulation-efficient PVT-aware sizing framework driven by an LLM agent. Combining elite-design reuse, analytic gm/Id local sizing and global refinement under full-corner verification, AnalogScout reduces power by 43.3% relative to the evolution strategy CMA-ES at an equal budget of 16k simulations on three SKY130 OTAs of increasing complexity, and reaches the final CMA-ES power after 7.0% of that budget. It also attains lower power than Bayesian optimization on all three OTAs and than two re-implemented LLM-driven flows on the two OTAs where they were tested.
summary_zh: 模拟电路全PVT角仿真耗时过长，现有代理优化与LLM方法仍依赖大量重复仿真，预算受限时成本高昂。
提出AnalogScout框架，由LLM代理驱动，结合精英设计复用、解析gm/Id局部尺寸优化与全局精炼。
在有限仿真预算下，该框架功耗较CMA-ES降低43.3%，仅需7%预算即可达CMA-ES最终功耗，且优于贝叶斯优化及其他LLM方法。
comment: 5 pages, 5 figures, 1 table. Submitted to IEEE ISCAS 2027

title: ReForest: Interpretability Meets Reasoning in Isolation Forest
title_zh: ReForest：隔离森林中可解释性与推理的结合
abstract: Statistical anomaly detection methods like Isolation Forest are efficient but suffer from a critical semantic gap. They identify numerical rarities but fail to understand the contextual meaning of data, often missing subtle, context-dependent anomalies. Conversely, Large Language Models possess strong semantic reasoning capabilities but are prohibitively expensive and slow for large-scale deployment. To bridge this gap, we propose ReForest, a novel framework that synergizes the statistical efficiency of Isolation Forest with the reasoning power of LLMs. ReForest transforms the latent decision paths of Isolation Forest into natural-language explanations, enabling an LLM to refine anomaly detection through an uncertainty-aware dynamic ensemble. This approach allows the model to adaptively weigh statistical and semantic signals based on uncertainty-driven instance-level confidence. Extensive experiments on four real-world datasets (Healthcare, Finance) demonstrate that ReForest significantly outperforms baselines, achieving an average 21% improvement in Recall and a 10% gain in F1-score. Our framework not only improves detection performance but also enhances model transparency by grounding semantic narratives in statistical evidence, providing interpretable rationales essential for high-stakes decision-making.
summary_zh: 传统隔离森林缺乏语义理解易漏检，而LLM大规模部署成本高，需融合两者优势。
提出ReForest框架，将隔离森林决策路径转为自然语言，利用LLM通过不确定性感知动态集成优化检测。
实验表明该方法Recall平均提升21%、F1提升10%，且基于统计证据生成可解释依据增强透明度。
journal_ref: Advances in Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining (PAKDD 2026), Lecture Notes in Computer Science, vol. 16600, pp. 628-639, Springer (2026)

title: Bayesian Inference of Expensive Simulators: Survey and Comparison of Design Choices
title_zh: 昂贵模拟器的贝叶斯推断：设计选择综述与比较
abstract: We present a survey of approaches to Bayesian inference with simulator forward models, focusing on settings with prohibitively expensive simulators. In this domain, Bayesian optimization-based methods have emerged as the most promising approach. We unify existing methods into a general framework, enabling consistent reasoning about shared algorithmic structure across the fragmented literature. Within this framework, we identify the primary design choices and perform a systematic empirical comparison of their effects on inference efficiency in terms of required simulation budget. A key result of our study is that inference efficiency is often dominated by the choice of surrogate-model response variable, as it directly governs the complexity of the modeled function. Specifically, we demonstrate that the prevalent scalar log-likelihood is a poor response variable, as it discards crucial information. Based on this insight, we introduce the concept of custom \emph{proxy variables}: transformations of simulator outputs engineered to retain more information and provide smoother response surfaces, substantially improving inference efficiency over standard response variables. We provide actionable guidance and a numerically robust Julia package to facilitate practical adoption of Bayesian optimization for simulator inverse problems.
summary_zh: 针对昂贵模拟器的贝叶斯推断问题，综述现有方法并统一为通用框架，以理清碎片化文献中的共享算法结构。
在统一框架下系统比较各设计选择对推断效率的影响，发现代理模型响应变量的选择起主导作用，而常用的标量对数似然会丢失关键信息。
提出自定义代理变量以保留更多信息并提供更平滑的响应面，显著提升推断效率，并提供了实用指南与Julia软件包。
comment: 25 pages, 8 figures. Accepted for publication in Statistics and Computing. This is the submitted manuscript; the revised version, including changes based on peer review, is available from the authors upon request

title: BenchMeUp: Building Software Engineering Benchmarks from Natural-Language Specifications
title_zh: 从自然语言规约自动构建软件工程基准测试
abstract: Software-engineering research relies on benchmarks that evaluate new techniques on a set of problem instances. Unfortunately, manually constructing benchmarks is labor-intensive, as researchers must find suitable instances, prepare execution environments, establish expected outcomes, and validate correctness. This paper presents BenchMeUp, an approach for automatically creating software-engineering benchmarks from natural-language specifications. Given a specification defining the desired instances, data sources, and evaluation procedures, BenchMeUp generates search rules and a construction plan, invokes parallel LLM agents that identify candidate instances and construct executable instances, validates the results in fresh execution environments, and packages the instances behind a unified command-line interface. We evaluate the approach on four tasks: program repair, issue reproduction, compiler autotuning, and fixing static-analysis warnings. Targeting 50 instances per task (200 in total), BenchMeUp constructs 198 instances, of which 196 (99\%) are successfully packaged. Search and construction take 36 minutes and \$0.79 per instance, on average. Evaluating eight existing techniques on the generated benchmarks, we find that 189 of 196 packaged instances (96\%) support end-to-end evaluation, allowing users to study the effectiveness of the techniques. Checking every constructed instance against its source, the specification, and its expected outcome, we find that 180 of 198 (91\%) meet all criteria, compared with 10 of 200 instances delivered by Codex (general-purpose coding agent). Overall, we show that LLM-based agents can automate benchmark construction across diverse software-engineering tasks and produce executable instances that existing techniques can use, while validity beyond execution still needs to be checked.
summary_zh: 人工构建软件工程基准测试费时费力，需寻找实例、配置环境并验证正确性。
提出BenchMeUp方法，利用并行LLM agent根据自然语言规约自动搜索、构建并验证可执行实例。
实验构建198个实例，99%成功打包，91%满足全部标准，证实LLM agent可自动化基准构建。

title: Where Should the Evaluation Budget Go in LLM-Driven Agent Scaffold Evolution?
title_zh: LLM驱动智能体架构演化的评估预算分配策略
abstract: Large language model (LLM)-driven agent scaffold evolution improves agent workflows through iterative candidate generation and evaluation. Evaluation both guides subsequent search and determines the final scaffold, but evaluating every candidate on the full task set incurs substantial execution costs. We investigate how evaluation budgets can be allocated across these two roles. Our experiments show that sparse feedback can sustain productive evolution, while additional targeted evaluation improves final selection. Replay analyses further show that shared informative items and a common scoring reference support comparisons among closely matched candidates. Motivated by these findings, we propose \method, an evaluation allocation framework that combines sparse search-time feedback with targeted final confirmation. A short fully evaluated warm-up establishes a shared informative core and calibrates a response model whose item parameters remain fixed during search. After search, \method refits the model and applies paired successive halving, reusing accumulated observations and executing only missing evaluations. Across four benchmarks and two evolution frameworks, \method achieves higher mean performance than full evaluation in most settings while using approximately half as many evaluation cells.
summary_zh: LLM智能体架构演化中全量评估成本高昂，需研究如何将评估预算分配给搜索引导与最终选择。
实验发现稀疏反馈可维持有效搜索，定向评估能提升最终选择，共享信息项与评分参考有助于对比候选。
提出结合稀疏搜索反馈与定向最终确认的评估分配框架，以半数评估量在多数设置下超越全量评估性能。

title: Personal preference or system role? Battery swapping among UK electric vehicle users
title_zh: 英国电动汽车用户的换电偏好：个人选择还是系统角色？
abstract: Battery swapping replaces a depleted EV battery with a charged one, reducing waiting time and enabling off-peak charging. Evidence on acceptance, however, remains concentrated in Asian markets, and most studies examine individual adoption intentions. This study asks whether current UK EV users judge swapping differently as a purchase option and as a technology for the transport system. Using Behavioural Reasoning Theory, an integrated choice and latent variable model, and latent class analysis, we analyse perceived usefulness, energy-system concerns, practical barriers, and satisfaction with current charging. Usefulness and energy-system concerns relate more strongly to expectations about the system. Battery compatibility and station coverage relate more strongly to personal preference, while spare battery costs relate to expectations about network viability. User groups differ in how they balance benefits, barriers, and satisfaction with existing charging. Policy should address driver barriers and network viability as distinct but connected priorities.
summary_zh: 现有换电接受度研究多集中于亚洲且偏重个人意愿，缺乏对用户将其视为个人选项与系统技术的差异分析。
基于行为推理理论与潜变量模型，分析英国用户对换电的感知有用性、能源系统担忧及实际障碍等。
不同因素对个人偏好与系统预期的影响各异，用户群体在权衡利弊上存在差异，政策需兼顾个人障碍与网络可行性。

title: Watermark Basins: Black-Box Detection of Distilled LLMs
title_zh: 水印盆地：黑盒检测蒸馏大语言模型
abstract: Proprietary language models and their reasoning traces are vulnerable to API-based distillation, where an adversary trains a student model on the teacher model's outputs. To obtain evidence of distillation, model providers can watermark the teacher's outputs, aiming to leave a radioactive signal in the student's outputs. Existing black-box detectors search for such radioactivity using token-level statistics of the suspect model's outputs. However, token-level signals are not always detectable, for instance when the distillation traces are sampled at a low temperature. In this work, we discover the watermark basin, a persistent signal that enables more reliable watermark detection: during fine-tuning, watermarked teacher traces embed a distinct, key-specific geometric signal in parameter space that lies orthogonal to the ordinary task-specific fine-tuning subspace. Building on this, we introduce Watermark Basin Alignment (WM-Basin), a black-box watermark detector that queries the suspect model through its API, without access to its weights or logits. WM-Basin maps generated text to gradient representations using a fixed clean probe model, projects out the ordinary fine-tuning task directions, and tests whether the residual gradient aligns with the watermark basin induced by the watermark key. We evaluate WM-Basin extensively across diverse teacher models and student architectures (from 135M to 8.2B parameters) distilled on mathematical reasoning. At a strict 0.1% false-positive rate, WM-Basin detects 79% of distilled models at n-gram=1 and 45% at n-gram=3, substantially improving over the state-of-the-art token-level baseline (29% and 1.3%, respectively). Because the watermark signal resides in a persistent basin, it survives post-distillation modifications including quantization, pruning, and reinforcement-learning post-training.
summary_zh: 现有黑盒检测基于token统计，在低温采样等场景下信号难以捕捉，无法有效检测蒸馏LLM。
发现水印盆地现象：微调时水印会在参数空间留下与常规任务正交的几何信号，提供更持久的检测依据。
提出WM-Basin黑盒检测器，通过探测模型梯度并投影去除任务方向，检测残差与水印的对齐情况，准确率大幅提升。

title: Your Policy Is Secretly a Harness: The Decision Geometry of Agent Interfaces
title_zh: 智能体接口的决策几何：策略隐含受控于控制框架
abstract: Language model agents are post-trained and deployed through a harness, the prompts, tools, and control logic that present a task to the model and execute its outputs. Harnesses are often revised and judged by how an already trained model performs under them, which assumes that what the model learned under one harness carries over to the next. We ask what a policy learns from its harness and what survives when the harness changes. Under KL-regularized control, we show that the log odds of an optimal policy recover how strongly its harness favors each action over the others, so a trained policy carries the preferences of its harness. Deployed return then equals the ceiling of the harness, the best return it offers, minus the mismatch of the policy, the return lost to its own suboptimal decisions. Training changes only the mismatch, while changing the harness moves both terms. Comparing harnesses with a fixed model therefore mixes what each harness offers with how well that model uses it. In MiniWoB++, post-training makes a model's preferences specific to its training harness. Reversing the order of the observation fields leaves every optimal decision unchanged yet lowers a trained model's success from 85.0% to 19.2%. Conversely, every new harness that a fixed-model comparison rejects but that raises the ceiling outperforms the original agent after further training under it, and ceiling and mismatch measured beforehand predict these gains. For coding-agent harnesses on Terminal-Bench Lite, ceiling minus mismatch estimated with a stronger model as a stand-in for the optimum reproduces the accuracy ranking, while either term alone does not. Code is available at https://github.com/2020-qqtcg/HRP.
summary_zh: 智能体策略会学习并继承其控制框架的偏好，框架改变时策略所学可能无法保留。
部署回报等于框架上限减去策略失配，训练仅减少失配，而换框架会同时改变两项。
实验表明框架上限与策略失配可预测智能体性能，仅比较固定模型表现会掩盖真实潜力。

title: Preserving Separation Logic Specifications through Compilation
title_zh: 通过编译保持分离逻辑规约
abstract: Program specifications in separation logic describe ownership of resources and serve as logical interfaces for local reasoning. Compiler correctness, expressed as semantics preservation, does not by itself supply such an interface for compiled code, because it does not explicitly relate source and target resources and assertions. We investigate WP-preserving compilation: when a compiler translates a source program, the weakest preconditions that the program satisfies in a separation logic carry over to the compiled program. Our proof technique consists of a resource-aware simulation over interaction trees: it relates the resources required by corresponding source and target events, and tracks ownership through target operations, such as register accesses, that have no source counterpart. We apply the approach to a compiler from a structured imperative language to an assembly-like language, first for closed programs and then extended with modules and function calls. In the extended setting, each module can be verified in the source logic and compiled separately; its specifications carry over to the compiled module and are preserved when compiled modules are linked. All results are mechanized in Rocq.
summary_zh: 编译器语义保持不显式关联源与目标资源，无法为编译后代码提供分离逻辑接口。
提出WP保持编译，使源程序满足的最弱前置条件在编译后程序中依然成立。
基于交互树的资源感知模拟证明技术，并扩展至模块级独立验证与链接，结果已在Rocq中机械化证明。
comment: 42 pages (25 pages main text, references, 13 pages of appendices), 6 figures, 1 table. Rocq mechanization available from the authors on request

title: Grounding LLM Agents in Business Processes: Process-Aware Knowledge Graphs for Reliable Multi-Step Service Invocation
title_zh: 基于流程感知知识图谱的LLM代理多步服务调用
abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents that call enterprise APIs must select the correct endpoints, follow process order, use valid payload keys, and choose coded values from predefined lists. However, current retrieval-augmented service discovery treats endpoints independently and therefore misses process and schema constraints. We address this limitation by integrating Open Data Protocol (OData) metadata and Business Process Model and Notation (BPMN) reference processes in a typed property graph. A hybrid retriever identifies candidate endpoints using dense embeddings and follows process edges to retrieve subsequent endpoints. We evaluate the method on 42 enterprise services with process-chain ground truth. For queries with low lexical overlap between the query and downstream entities, it improves Recall@3 by 5.7 points (n=74), with consistent gains across embedding models and cut-offs. It matches dense retrieval on other queries and provides no improvement on OpenAPI services without a process layer, indicating that the gains arise from process structure. We also evaluate an LLM agent on 81 multi-step queries. It completes 38.7% of tasks, compared with 10.3% for a chunk-based baseline. In an elicitation probe, providing valid code lists eliminates invented codes but leaves invalid keys in 46% of write runs. Full typed context reduces invalid calls to 3% (3 of 101 runs), with no invented codes. These results show that exposing process and schema constraints during retrieval improves the reliability of agent-driven API calls.
summary_zh: 现有LLM代理调用API时独立检索端点，忽略了流程顺序与模式约束，导致调用不可靠。
提出将OData元数据与BPMN流程整合为类型化属性图，采用混合检索器依流程边获取后续端点。
实验表明该方法显著提升低词汇重叠查询的召回率，且使LLM代理多步任务完成率升至38.7%，无效调用降至3%。

title: AutoRSE: Evaluating LLM Agents as Recommendation Engineers for Self-Evolving Recommender Systems
title_zh: AutoRSE：评估LLM代理作为自演化推荐系统工程师
abstract: Recommender Systems Engineer Agents (RSE-Agents), which use LLM-based agents to autonomously improve recommendation algorithms, are emerging as a promising paradigm. However, their capabilities and limitations remain poorly understood due to the lack of a unified, standardized evaluation framework and systematic trajectory-level analysis. To address this gap, we introduce AutoRSE, an evaluation framework spanning six representative industrial-grade recommendation tasks, and conduct a large-scale empirical study of three frontier LLMs across three widely used agent harnesses. Our results show that RSE-Agents consistently enhance the performance of backbones on five of the six tasks, with an average relative improvement of 16.1%, indicating that they can already autonomously improve recommendation performance. However, trajectory-level analysis also reveals that current RSE-Agents function primarily as engineering optimizers rather than algorithmic improvers: their gains are largely driven by hyperparameter tuning, training strategies, and model ensembling, while genuine algorithmic innovations are rare. Since the largest gains in recommender systems often stem from algorithmic advances, this behavior underscores a fundamental limitation of current RSE-Agents. To probe this limitation, we perform idea-injection experiments and show that agents equipped with innovative ideas from frontier research or human experts achieve substantially larger improvements than those relying on self-generated ideas. These results suggest that idea generation is a central bottleneck of current RSE-Agents, highlights a key direction for the future recommendation system research. Our implementation is publicly available on GitHub: https://github.com/Ray-Tiann/AutoRSE.
summary_zh: 现有RSE-Agents缺乏统一评估框架与轨迹分析，本文提出AutoRSE框架并在6项任务上开展大规模实证研究。
实验表明RSE-Agents在5项任务上平均提升16.1%，但其增益主要源于超参调优等工程优化，缺乏算法创新。
想法注入实验证实，想法生成是当前RSE-Agents的核心瓶颈，注入前沿想法可获更大提升，指明未来研究方向。

title: Spine: Compiling Subtask Trees into Structured Context for Long-Horizon Coding Agents
title_zh: Spine：将子任务树编译为长程编码Agent的结构化上下文
abstract: Long-horizon coding tasks contain nested subtasks. Typically, agents record interactions sequentially into a growing history, causing context inflation and performance degradation. Compressing or trimming the history without explicit subtask boundaries can discard information needed by unfinished subtasks. Conversely, recursive subagent delegation isolates completed subtasks through child agents by assigning every subtask boundary to delegation, which conflates subtask granularity with executing agent choice, adding execution and coordination overhead. We introduce Spine, an interface and runtime that align model context with subtask nesting and completion. An agent declares explicit subtask boundaries through work scopes, allowing the same agent to execute nested subtasks inline while reserving delegation for independent parallel tasks. The runtime organizes execution in SpineTree, a persistent tree recording subtask relations, local interactions, completion states, and returned results. Before each model call, it compiles the tree into model context just in time, retaining unfinished subtasks' interactions and replacing completed subtasks' details with their results, while preserving prefix-cache reuse. We integrate Spine into Codex to build SpineCodex. With GPT-5.6 Sol, compared with native Codex, SpineCodex improves SWE-Milestone Score by 11.8% while reducing total cost by 32.4%, improves the average ProgramBench test-pass rate by 17.3%, and improves Mean@5 on eight of the ten evaluated FrontierSWE tasks. On SWE-Milestone, it also achieves a comparable Score to Recursive Subagent at 73.7% lower total cost. We also integrate Spine into Pi through a reusable software package: with Gemini 3.8 Flash and Qwen 3.8 27B, it improves SWE-Milestone Score by 9.5-17.5% and the average ProgramBench test-pass rate by 4.3-8.7% compared with native Pi.
summary_zh: 长程编码任务的顺序历史记录易致上下文膨胀，而递归子Agent委派会引入执行与协调开销。
提出Spine接口与运行时，通过工作作用域声明子任务边界，支持内联执行嵌套子任务并构建持久化子任务树。
运行时按需将树编译为上下文，保留未完成子任务交互并用结果替换已完成细节；集成Codex后性能提升且成本降低32.4%。
递归子Agent委派将子任务粒度与执行Agent选择混淆，增加了执行和协调开销。

title: Zhengrong-Spatial-Aware 1.0: Advancing 3D Multimodal Intelligence
title_zh: Zhengrong-Spatial-Aware 1.0：推进3D多模态智能
abstract: This report presents the implementation and validation of two end-to-end multimodal adaptation pipelines for 3D-aware visual question answering on a custom spatial dataset. The first pipeline fine-tunes HiSpatial-3B, which augments RGB observations with metric-scale 3D point maps; the second adapts Qwen3-VL through memory-efficient QLoRA-based supervised fine-tuning. The completed engineering stack covers dataset conversion, image-annotation alignment, monocular geometry preprocessing, instruction construction, mixed-domain training, checkpoint management, batch inference, and automated evaluation. On the target spatial benchmark, HiSpatial adaptation increases overall accuracy from 1.73% before fine-tuning to 79.89% at 3,600 steps. On a separately collected styled split, accuracy improves from 14.9% to 55.1%, indicating transfer beyond the original training set. The Qwen3-VL pipeline is likewise implemented end-to-end for both 8B- and 32B-scale models using mixed-domain QLoRA adaptation. The resulting accuracy improves from 20.74% to 45.27% for Qwen3-VL-8B and from 30.79% to 47.60% for Qwen3-VL-32B. Together, these results establish two complementary and reproducible adaptation pipelines for geometry-aware and general-purpose multimodal spatial reasoning. These results establish a reproducible engineering foundation for subsequent work on metric 3D reasoning, spatial grounding, and domain-adapted multimodal systems, while also identifying training-data composition as a central factor in preserving general multimodal capability during specialization.
summary_zh: 针对3D空间视觉问答问题，构建端到端多模态适配流水线，微调HiSpatial-3B与Qwen3-VL模型，显著提升空间推理精度。
HiSpatial-3B融合RGB与3D点云图，微调后目标基准精度从1.73%升至79.89%，且在新数据集上展现泛化能力。
基于QLoRA适配Qwen3-VL-8B与32B模型，精度分别提升至45.27%和47.60%，揭示了训练数据构成对保持通用能力的关键作用。
为度量3D推理与空间定位提供可复现工程基础，确立了几何感知与通用多模态空间推理的互补适配方案。

title: Uncovering Shortcut Amplification in Video RLVR through the Lens of Perceptual Uncertainty Collapse
title_zh: 视频RLVR中的感知不确定性坍塌与捷径放大效应
abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has emerged as an effective post-training paradigm for enhancing the video reasoning capability of Large Multimodal Models (LMMs). Despite its empirical effectiveness, we show that outcome-level optimization can introduce an undesirable shortcut amplification effect, whereby models increasingly favor text-prior answers even when they are not supported by the visual evidence. To characterize this behavior, we investigate the training dynamics of video RLVR through the lens of perceptual uncertainty, analyzing how predictive uncertainty evolves under video-conditioned and text-only contexts. Our analysis identifies a perceptual uncertainty collapse phenomenon, in which RL training continuously sharpens the model's answer distribution while the uncertainty reduction attributable to visual evidence progressively diminishes. A further gradient-direction analysis reveals that such confidence enhancement becomes increasingly less aligned with visually grounded uncertainty reduction and is instead dominated by text-prior compression. Motivated by these findings, we propose Bifocal Self-distillation Policy Optimization (BSPO), a self-distillation framework that regulates policy updates with two complementary distributional signals. Specifically, BSPO derives empirical reasoning principles from intra-group correct and incorrect rollouts to identify reasoning-sensitive tokens, and introduces shortcut-aware visual perturbation to penalize predictions that remain invariant when task-relevant visual evidence is weakened. By adaptively reweighting the original RL advantage, BSPO preserves the task-solving benefits of RLVR while promoting updates that are both reasoning-sensitive and visually grounded. Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness of BSPO in improving video reasoning performance and strengthening visual faithfulness.
summary_zh: 视频RLVR的输出级优化会导致捷径放大，模型偏向文本先验答案而忽视视觉证据。
分析训练动态发现感知不确定性坍塌现象，梯度逐渐被文本先验压缩主导，偏离视觉不确定性缩减。
提出BSPO框架，结合组内自蒸馏与视觉扰动惩罚，自适应重加权RL优势，保持求解能力并增强视觉推理。

title: SimplexLoRA: Dynamic Rank Updating via Alternating Minimization with Simplex Projection
title_zh: SimplexLoRA：基于单纯形投影交替最小化的动态秩更新
abstract: The success of large language models in real-world applications relies on parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods such as Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), which inserts compact, trainable adapters into selected layers. In this paper, we propose SimplexLoRA, a LoRA variant that adaptively adjusts adapter ranks during fine-tuning based on their learned importance. Unlike standard LoRA, which employs a fixed rank across all layers, SimplexLoRA optimizes per-adapter importance weights on the $n$-scaled simplex during a short warm-up and then freezes them, dynamically allocating capacity where it is most beneficial without increasing the overall parameter budget or inference cost. We evaluate SimplexLoRA across 12 language understanding, summarization, and reasoning tasks using DeBERTaV3, BART-large, Llama 3.1 8B, and Qwen3-8B. Our results show that SimplexLoRA consistently matches or outperforms standard LoRA and recent adaptive baselines, with the largest gains at low ranks. Our code is available at https://github.com/brain-lab-research/SimplexLoRA.
summary_zh: 标准LoRA固定适配器秩，无法按层重要性动态分配容量，限制了微调效果。
提出SimplexLoRA，在短暂预热期于单纯形上优化并冻结各适配器重要性权重，动态调整秩。
该方法不增加参数与推理开销，在12项任务上持续匹配或超越LoRA及自适应基线，低秩下优势最大。

title: 3D-SceneQ: Empowering 3D LLM With Query-Guided Adaptive Pruning and Multi-Modal Feature Enhancement
title_zh: 3D-SceneQ：基于查询引导剪枝与多模态增强的3D LLM
abstract: Current 3D scene understanding pipelines typically concatenate vast numbers of 3D object tokens with text tokens and feed the resulting sequence to a Large Language Model (LLM). However, existing 3D-LLMs for scene understanding encounter two major limitations: (i) excessive inclusion of task-irrelevant object data, introducing noise that reduces reasoning accuracy and increases hallucinations; and (ii) reliance solely on point cloud data, which inherently lacks the rich semantic information available in complementary 2D modalities, such as color, material properties, texture, and high-level contextual relationships. To address these challenges, we introduce 3D-SceneQ, a 3D LLM that unifies adaptive token pruning with multimodal semantic enrichment, markedly advancing scene understanding, reasoning, and grounding. Specifically, we propose a Query-Guided Adaptive Pruning (QGAP) module that adaptively selects task-relevant objects based on the intended meaning of user instructions, leveraging a learnable latent query to retain critical information while effectively suppressing irrelevant noise. In addition, we introduce a Multi-modal Object-level Feature Enhancement (MOFE) module, which integrates 2D feature embeddings from pre-trained models into 3D representation to enrich object-level semantic information. Evaluations show that 3D-SceneQ outperforms current state-of-the-art methods across multiple benchmarks (e.g., +5.7 CIDEr on Scan2Cap and +17.0 EM@1 on SQA3D), demonstrating its remarkable capabilities in various 3D language reasoning tasks.
summary_zh: 现有3D LLM包含过多任务无关3D对象引入噪声，且仅依赖点云缺乏2D丰富语义，导致推理不准和幻觉。
提出3D-SceneQ模型，设计QGAP模块根据用户指令自适应剪枝保留关键信息，并引入MOFE模块融合2D特征丰富3D语义。
实验表明3D-SceneQ在多个基准上超越SOTA（如Scan2Cap +5.7 CIDEr），显著提升3D语言推理能力。
comment: 13 pages, 8 figures, 8 tables. Published in IEEE Transactions on Multimedia
journal_ref: IEEE Transactions on Multimedia, vol. 28, pp. 5972-5983, 2026

title: Conditional Values: The Contingent Foundations of Attitudes toward Artificial Intelligence
title_zh: 条件价值观：人工智能态度的偶然基础
abstract: How do broader values shape whether people judge artificial intelligence (AI) as good or bad for humanity? This article analyzes provisional World Values Survey Wave 8 data from 40,960 respondents in 24 country samples using pooled and national prediction models, outcome-independent respondent profiles, and groups of countries. The analysis reveals a cross-country anchor: general optimism about science and technology is the strongest pooled predictor of favorable AI evaluation and recurs among the leading predictors in every national sample. Expert authority, education and information access, selected forms of trust, openness, and demographic position provide nationally distinctive patterns. Eleven value profiles formed without AI attitudes span 49.1% to 62.2% favorable evaluation. Most evaluative variation occurs within these profiles, making them useful contexts for identifying how the same values distinguish favorable from unfavorable evaluators in different social configurations. Institutional legitimacy, structural advantage, information connectedness, personal choice, redistribution, and openness differentiate evaluations in particular profiles. The same axis can relate differently to AI evaluation across profiles: secular reasoning has a significant positive association among secular moderate pluralists but a suggestive negative association among institution-trusting civic joiners. Together, the findings show that public receptivity to AI as technological change has a common predictive anchor but develops within plural configurations of resources, institutions, authority, openness, and social position. This distinction helps anticipate where generalized technological optimism is likely to travel and where AI deployment and governance will encounter context-specific sources of legitimacy or concern.
summary_zh: 探究宏观价值观如何影响公众对AI的评价，基于24国4万余份世界价值观调查数据，使用预测模型与受访者画像进行分析。
发现对科技的乐观态度是跨国家预测AI好评的最强共同锚点，而专家权威、教育、信任等则呈现国家特异性模式。
揭示公众对AI的接纳有共同预测锚点，但发展于多元配置中；同一价值轴在不同社会配置下对AI评价的影响方向可能相反。
comment: 41 pages, including supplementary appendix. Research materials: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23688866

title: VGIQA: Fine-Grained Image Quality Assessment with Visual Grounding Rewards
title_zh: 基于视觉定位奖励的细粒度图像质量评估
abstract: Image quality assessment (IQA) aims to evaluate the perceptual visual quality of images. Recently, the rapid development of Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) has significantly advanced the IQA field. By integrating chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning and reinforcement learning (RL), these models can generate more accurate and interpretable results while relying on less training data. However, existing MLLM-based methods are predominantly constrained to holistic, image-level evaluations and lack the capability to produce fine-grained, localized assessments, which substantially limits their practical applicability. To address this limitation, we propose VGIQA, a novel IQA model endowed with both local and global quality assessment capabilities. VGIQA is trained via a two-stage paradigm comprising a cold-start phase followed by reinforcement learning. Driven by carefully designed local quality assessment reward functions, our model exhibits exceptional image quality understanding on VGSR-2K, a new dataset we propose specifically for local quality evaluation, significantly outperforming existing open-source MLLMs such as Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct and Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct. Furthermore, the local quality evaluation task can effectively enhance the model's performance on the degradation perception task.
summary_zh: 现有基于MLLM的图像质量评估仅限全局评价，缺乏细粒度局部评估能力，限制其实用性。
提出VGIQA模型，采用冷启动与强化学习两阶段训练，结合局部质量评估奖励函数实现细粒度评估。
在新建局部评估数据集VGSR-2K上显著优于现有开源MLLM，且局部评估有效提升退化感知任务性能。
comment: 20 pages, 5 figures, 6 tables; main paper: 4 figures and 4 tables, appendix: 1 figure and 2 tables

title: SFE-O: An Ontology for Knowledge-Grounded AI in Supercritical CO$_2$ Biomass Extraction and Fractionation
title_zh: 超临界CO₂生物质提取与分馏的知识本体SFE-O
abstract: Supercritical CO$_2$ extraction (CO$_2$-SFE) offers a sustainable route for recovering high-value compounds from biomass while limiting the use of conventional organic solvents, but its design and interpretation require heterogeneous knowledge spanning biomass properties, operating conditions, mass transfer, and product fractionation, typically fragmented across technical reports, engineering models, external databases, and expert practice. This paper introduces SFE-O, a modular Web Ontology Language (OWL 2) ontology for supercritical CO$_2$ biomass extraction, structured around interconnected Biomass, Process, and Product dimensions and extended with explicit representations of process topology, parameter provenance, external and internal mass-transfer phenomena, and the Constant Extraction Rate (CER) / Falling Extraction Rate (FER) mechanisms. Computational dependencies among process quantities are represented explicitly, without embedding numerical solving in the ontology, so that input, measured, computed, externally retrieved, and fitted parameters remain traceable. SFE-O reuses established semantic resources (ChEBI, QUDT, OWL-Time, PROV-O) and is evaluated through a worked example that instantiates a real pilot-scale extraction batch, a reasoner-based consistency check, and a competency-question SPARQL query. The resulting knowledge model provides a machine-actionable foundation for querying, consistency checking, and mechanistic explanation of SFE processes, and establishes a knowledge layer that could support future ontology-grounded AI reasoning, a direction this paper motivates but does not evaluate.
summary_zh: 超临界CO₂提取设计需跨领域异构知识，现有知识碎片化分散，难以统一查询与推理。
提出模块化OWL 2本体SFE-O，围绕生物质、过程和产品维度构建，显式表达过程拓扑、传质现象及参数溯源。
构建了支持查询、一致性检查和机理解释的机器可操作知识模型，为未来基于本体的AI推理奠定基础。
journal_ref: IEEE ICAI-TEMS 2026, International Conference on Application of Information Technologies in Engineering, Management and Science, Nov 2026, Pise (Italie), Italy

title: Prospector: learning a compact graph traversal policy for scientific reasoning
title_zh: Prospector：面向科学推理的紧凑图遍历策略学习
abstract: Scientific reasoning in specialized engineering fields depends on knowledge scattered across the literature, often proprietary and absent from frontier LLM training data. In such domains, frontier models tend to give generic answers. Knowledge graphs (KGs) can ground LLM reasoning. Because a graph is too large to provide in full, typical LLM+KG systems preselect a portion, deciding relevance before reasoning begins. Here we train a compact model, Prospector, to reason over a domain knowledge graph by traversing it step by step, seeking evidence in light of what it has already found. Prospector calls a small set of tools one at a time to progressively build its context, and answers with a chain of evidence that can be checked edge by edge against what its tools retrieved from the graph. On a knowledge graph built from the semiconductor-manufacturing literature, Prospector approaches the strongest off-the-shelf models given the same graph and tools, and it far exceeds off-the-shelf models answering closed-book or from a pre-selected portion of the graph. Although trained only on the semiconductor graph, Prospector transfers to unseen knowledge graphs from three other distinct fields: bio-inspired materials, per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) and materials properties. Served on a single GPU, Prospector answers faster and at a fraction of the cost of a hosted service, while keeping proprietary data on the owner's hardware. We find that the policy's latent state is indicative of its next move on both seen and unseen graphs, and modulating the latent state can steer the policy from one behavior mode to another. These results suggest a practical LLM + KG paradigm for scientific and engineering reasoning over private data, in which a compact model trained on a graph from published literature transfers its traversal to unseen graphs that stay with their owners.
summary_zh: 前沿LLM在专业工程领域因缺乏私有数据常给出泛化回答，且现有LLM+KG系统多在推理前预选子图，无法动态寻证。
提出Prospector模型，通过逐步遍历知识图谱并调用工具渐进构建上下文，实现基于已发现证据的动态推理与寻证。
该模型在半导体图谱上逼近最强基线且远超闭卷与预选子图方法，可零样本迁移至其他领域，且推理快、成本低、保护隐私。

title: Text Generation in Low-Resource Languages Using Human-Curated Vocabularies
title_zh: 利用人工词汇表生成低资源语言文本
abstract: Synthetic text generation offers a promising approach to alleviating data scarcity in low-resource languages. However, its effectiveness is inherently limited for languages that are scarcely represented, or entirely absent, in an LLM's pretraining data. At the same time, many such languages have human-curated vocabularies that provide rich lexical and semantic information, often accompanied by grammatical information such as part-of-speech labels. In this work, we ask whether LLMs can leverage these resources to generate coherent text in extremely low-resource and unseen languages. We introduce a framework that combines human-curated vocabularies with a small number of human-written exemplars that provide syntactic signals, while sampling candidate words according to a Zipfian distribution. Across languages with varying levels of resource availability, we evaluate the generated text using lexical diversity, off-target ratio, and human judgments of fluency. Our results show that reasoning-enabled LLMs can generate fluent text even in extremely low-resource languages, with particularly strong results at the sentence level and promising performance at the paragraph level. Our findings highlight a practical pathway for bootstrapping synthetic data in low-resource languages, expanding the amount of usable text even when existing digital resources are extremely limited. Our source code is available at https://github.com/michaelsinanta/vocab2text.
summary_zh: 低资源语言在LLM预训练数据中稀缺，导致合成文本生成困难，需探索新方法利用现有语言资源。
提出结合人工词汇表与少量人工示例提供句法信号，并按Zipfian分布采样候选词的文本生成框架。
推理型LLM可生成流畅的低资源语言文本，为在数字资源极度受限下引导合成数据提供了实用路径。

title: Learning to Look Beyond Screens: Transferable Visual Observation from GUI Grounding
title_zh: 从GUI定位学习可迁移的视觉观察：超越屏幕
abstract: Visual perception is evolving from passive recognition toward active, task-oriented observation. We investigate GUI grounding as a scalable source of spatial supervision for learning observation behaviors that transfer beyond interfaces. We introduce LBS (Look Beyond Screens), a vision-language model trained through supervised initialization on teacher-generated GUI grounding trajectories, followed by reinforcement learning for multi-turn crop-and-inspect decisions. Under fixed inference settings, LBS models based on Qwen3.5-35B-A3B and Qwen3.8-27B consistently improve over their corresponding baselines. Gains beyond supervised fine-tuning transfer to PerceptionBench for both backbones and to HR-Bench and ChartQAPro for Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, supporting observation strategies that generalize beyond GUI-specific imitation. Further analysis suggests complementary roles for the two stages: SFT establishes visual inspection primitives, while RL improves their downstream effectiveness. These findings support GUI grounding as a practical supervision paradigm for transferable active visual perception and broader multimodal reasoning. Our code and model are publicly available at https://github.com/inclusionAI/UI-Venus/tree/LBS and https://huggingface.co/inclusionAI/LBS-27B, respectively.
summary_zh: 现有视觉感知多为被动识别，需探索可迁移至界面外的主动观察行为监督范式。
提出LBS模型，先经SFT学习GUI定位轨迹，再用RL优化多轮裁剪与检查决策。
LBS在多个基准上超越基线，证明GUI定位可作为可迁移主动视觉感知的有效监督。

title: OpenGray: a benchmark for evaluating the decisions of radiotherapy planning agents
title_zh: OpenGray：评估放疗规划Agent决策的基准
abstract: Background and purpose: Radiotherapy planning agents based on large language models (LLMs) decide when to submit a plan or request review but are evaluated mainly by dose. This study developed OpenGray, a benchmark of planning tasks with known correct decisions. Materials and methods: OpenGray adds tasks with known answers to the OpenKBP-Opt head-and-neck dataset, including two contradictions with dose goals proven incompatible and a feasible control with a stored plan meeting every hard goal. Four systems, from a rule-based planning script to a full LLM agent, were evaluated on 30 patients, the LLM-based ones with a commercial (Terra) and a local (Ministral 3 8B) LLM. Decisions, achieved dose, problem recognition, and technical failures were recorded and also read from logs of 39 stereotactic radiosurgery runs of SAGE, a clinical LLM agent. Results: With Terra, the script preceded by an LLM review and the full agent had decision accuracies of 95.4% and 92.1%, respectively, yet escalated only 50% (95% confidence interval, 25-75%) and 25% (10-40%) of overlap contradictions, which required arithmetic on the anatomy. All four systems submitted every feasible control, but 24% of these plans missed a hard goal that the stored plan had met. In four SAGE runs, one goal failed at every attempt; the agent identified it in every reply but had no action for stopping. Conclusions: Favorable aggregate scores concealed specific decision failures. Planning agents should be evaluated on their decisions as well as their dose and given an explicit action for stopping and requesting review.
summary_zh: 问题：基于LLM的放疗规划Agent缺乏对其决策（如提交或请求审查）的评估，现有评估仅关注剂量。
方法：构建OpenGray基准，在头颈部数据集中加入已知正确决策的任务，评估四种系统及临床LLM Agent的决策表现。
结论：总体高分掩盖了特定决策失败，规划Agent除剂量外还需评估决策，并应具备显式的停止与审查动作。
comment: 25 pages, 4 figures, 1 table, and the supplementary material (19 tables, 5 figures). Ancillary files: the paper in Markdown, structured results with the sentence each comes from, and an llms.txt index for AI agents

title: Tessera: Structure-Completed Evidence Units for Web Retrieval-Augmented Generation
title_zh: Tessera：面向Web RAG的结构完整证据单元
abstract: Web retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) splits a page into fixed-size text chunks or, in recent visual pipelines, screenshot tiles, and the retrieved item serves at once as the unit of indexing, ranking, and reading. We trace answer evidence from source HTML to reader input over the full English Wikipedia and find that this coupling loses evidence in text and screenshot pipelines alike: evidence present in the source page often fails to reach the reader intact, particularly structured content such as tables and infoboxes, which chunking separates from the headers and context that give it meaning. Stronger extraction, context expansion, and larger reader budgets leave the loss in place. We present Tessera, a training-free evidence delivery layer that decouples what a pipeline retrieves from what its reader reads. Given the pages behind any ranked list, Tessera rebuilds their HTML into fine-grained evidence units, each completed with its page title, section path, and table headers, selects the units relevant to the query, and packs them into the reader context at an unchanged token budget. The index, the retriever, and the reader stay as they are, so Tessera applies to text, screenshot, and agentic pipelines. Across three question answering benchmarks, Tessera improves answer accuracy by 5 to 6 points on text and screenshot pipelines, consistently across readers, retrievers, and reader budgets, and outperforms strong HTML-aware and structure-aware RAG baselines under matched budgets. The gains carry over to multi-step agentic search. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/sarendis56/Tessera.
summary_zh: Web RAG将页面分块检索，导致表格等结构化内容与标题上下文分离，造成证据丢失。
提出Tessera，一种免训练的证据交付层，将HTML重建为包含标题和表头的细粒度完整证据单元。
在三个QA基准上，Tessera在文本与截图RAG中提升5-6个准确度点，优于强基线且适用于多步agent搜索。

title: Hierarchical Low-Rank Reparameterization for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning
title_zh: 面向参数高效微调的层级低秩重参数化方法
abstract: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods adapt large models by introducing a small number of trainable parameters. However, we find that these parameters still contain redundancy and can be further compressed while maintaining strong task performance. To this end, we propose a novel hierarchical low-rank reparameterization method. Its core idea is to reorganize the trainable parameters of PEFT methods into an approximately square matrix and then express it via a low-rank decomposition, which can be applied recursively. This forms a multi-level structure with factors compressed level by level, drastically reducing the number of trainable parameters. In our experiments, we combine this reparameterization with LoRA, DoRA, MoSA, and RaSA. We evaluate commonsense reasoning on LLaMA-3.1-8B and Qwen2.5-7B, with additional GSM8K math reasoning experiments on LLaMA-3.1-8B. Under comparable trainable-parameter budgets, our method combined with LoRA or DoRA achieves better performance. Furthermore,when the parameter count of the original methods is compressed by approximately an order of magnitude, our method can still maintain competitive task performance and even surpass the corresponding baselines in average accuracy across the eight commonsense reasoning benchmarks.
summary_zh: 现有PEFT方法的可训练参数仍存冗余，需在保持性能下进一步压缩。
提出层级低秩重参数化，将PEFT参数重组为近似方阵并递归低秩分解，逐级压缩参数量。
结合LoRA等方法在同等参数预算下性能更优，压缩约一个数量级时仍具竞争力甚至超越基线。
comment: 14 pages, 2 figures, 10 tables, including references and appendices

title: Blindfold: Keeping the Audit Coin Secret from LLM Agents
title_zh: Blindfold：对LLM代理隐藏审计硬币
abstract: Audit-based certification bounds the violation rate of an LLM agent by auditing a random fraction $\varepsilon$ of actions and reweighting the audited labels; its validity is meant to rest only on the defender's audit coin. We show that it also rests on a confidentiality property: the coin must not interfere with the agent's view before the action commits, at a time the agent chooses. We call this pre-commit noninterference (PNI) and measure its violation by $D_{\mathrm{A}}$, the total-variation distance between the agent's views under the two coin values. PNI is necessary and sufficient for an unbiased certificate against adaptive agents, the worst-case bias is $(1-\varepsilon)D_{\mathrm{A}}$, and no procedure that sees only audited labels can pay less. Leakage composes across steps, a resource shared across episodes opens a channel of computable size, and raising the audit rate cannot restore validity. On a monitor we built, a silent audit changes no output but adds latency that tool timestamps expose, and the agent can enlarge it. A real LLM agent follows an injection that names a visible audit notice (generic, tool, and timing clauses have no effect); over that channel the plain certificate fails on measured labels and, by a post-hoc analysis, in a live run on a pre-registered schedule, while a silent audit restores it. A fresh coin per audited call closes the timing channel; padding only narrows it.
summary_zh: 问题：基于审计的LLM代理认证依赖审计硬币的机密性，若硬币在动作提交前泄露给代理，会导致证书偏差。
方法：提出预提交不干扰（PNI）属性，用全变差距离衡量违规程度，并构建监控器分析时序与注入等泄露通道。
结论：PNI是无偏证书的充要条件，最坏偏差为(1-ε)D_A；每次审计调用使用新硬币可关闭时序通道并恢复证书有效性。

title: Learning to Code the World: Harness Evolution for Compositional 3D Reconstruction
title_zh: 利用进化实现组合式3D重建：学习编码世界
abstract: Reconstructing editable and compositional 3D scenes from a real image requires jointly reasoning about geometry, object structure, and spatial relationships. We introduce SceneEvolve, a framework that represents 3D scenes as executable code and improves reconstruction by evolving the harness around a small open-source agent. SceneEvolve combines SceneAct, a compositional semantic action interface built on parameterized primitives, hierarchical composition, and semantic spatial relations, with SceneHarness-RSI, which leverages a stronger teacher agent to iteratively evolve the harness using feedback from development-set reconstructions. Throughout harness evolution, the model parameters, action semantics, and execution backend remain fixed. The resulting harness provides a reusable reconstruction procedure that enables the small open-source model to reconstruct unseen scenes without parameter updates or teacher assistance. Across two in-domain datasets and one out-of-domain dataset, SceneEvolve with the comparatively compact Qwen3.8-27B model improves all four evaluated reconstruction metrics while reducing mean inference time by 47.0% relative to the base model. More notably, despite relying on a substantially smaller model, SceneEvolve achieves 32.3% higher reconstruction quality than the large proprietary GPT-5.6-Sol model, while reducing mean equivalent deployment cost by 59.8%. Furthermore, the harness evolved using Qwen3.8-27B also generalizes to Kimi-K3, achieving comparable reconstruction performance to GPT-6-Astra. The project page is https://haoyu-agent.github.io/SceneEvolve.
summary_zh: 从单图重建可编辑组合3D场景需联合推理几何与空间关系，现有方法难以兼顾效率与质量。
提出SceneEvolve框架，将3D场景表示为可执行代码，利用强教师agent迭代进化harness以优化小开源agent的重建能力。
